_note: Shared bibliography for elementCategories.json and elementStories.json. 'accessed' is the date the text was actually read and compared against the claims citing it; null means the work is cited for background but its text was not available to the author (e.g. paywalled), so claims relying only on it remain unverified. Per-element PubChem pages are referenced as 'pubchem-element:<Z>' and CIAAW element pages as 'ciaaw:<name>'; those are resolved in src/lib/content.ts. 'elementPagesRead' records the date each element's PubChem record was downloaded and read; citing an element page that is not listed there is an error.

iupac-redbook-2005.citation: IUPAC. Nomenclature of Inorganic Chemistry — IUPAC Recommendations 2005 (Red Book). N. G. Connelly, T. Damhus, R. M. Hartshorn, A. T. Hutton (eds.). RSC Publishing, 2005. §IR-3.5 Elements in the periodic table, p. 51.

iupac-group3-2021.citation: IUPAC Project 2015-039-2-200, The constitution of group 3 of the periodic table (chair: E. R. Scerri). Provisional recommendation, 2021.

pubchem-periodic-table.citation: National Center for Biotechnology Information. PubChem Periodic Table of Elements (GroupBlock classification).

vernon-2013.citation: R. E. Vernon. Which Elements Are Metalloids? Journal of Chemical Education 2013, 90 (12), 1703–1707.

greenwood-earnshaw-1997.citation: N. N. Greenwood, A. Earnshaw. Chemistry of the Elements, 2nd ed. Butterworth-Heinemann, 1997.

pyykko-1988.citation: P. Pyykkö. Relativistic Effects in Structural Chemistry. Chemical Reviews 1988, 88 (3), 563–594.
